        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "main (zapabob独自 + 公式統合)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",

          },
          {
            "text": "├── gemini-cli-mcp-server/  // 独自: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── src/",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "│   │   └── main.rs",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── Cargo.toml",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "└── deep-research/           // 拡張: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 🔔 Marisa音声通知システム",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスク完了時の音声通知",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Marisaキャラクター音声",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows/macOS/Linux対応",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 統合ポイント",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "# config.toml",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "[hooks]",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "on_task_complete = \"powershell -File zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          }
        ]
